snippet.title: Everything is Crab | Official Launch Trailer 🦀
snippet.description:
Everything is Crab has reached its next evolution, and is OUT NOW on Steam and Epic Games Store! 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3526710/Everything_is_Crab_The_Animal_Evolution_Roguelite/

Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/everything-is-crab-08aaf7

In this animal evolution roguelite, become Darwin, an amorphous blue blob with infinite potential, thrown into a living ecosystem where you need to feed and avoid becoming food. 

Fight and flee as you feast on fruit, fungi, and/or flesh to level up. Choose from over 100 evolutions and more than 20 specialisations granting new arms, legs, wings, eyes, fur, and so, so much more to help you carve out your own niche on the evolutionary tree.

As well as the game launching, a Supporter Pack is available on Steam! This adds Ghost Crab-themed cosmetics to the evolutions: Exoskeleton, Pincer, Pistol Pincer, and More Eyes for £3.99 / $4.99 / €4.99. This paid content provides an option to further support the Crab team, if you wish - and in the process, you unlock visual items to show off, which do not alter gameplay or progression one bit. You'll just look extra stylish.

Also check out the Steam store page for exclusive bundles with other cool games, including Vampire Survivors!

Follow Secret Mode: https://linktr.ee/wearesecretmode
